description.fun: Tapu Bulu, guardian of Ula'ula Island, can make plants grow and change shape at will, yet it does so little that some call it lazy. It's peaceful and rings the bell on its tail so others know it's coming, but it shows no mercy to those who offend it: it's said to have driven thieves from its ruins by swinging trees like clubs.
description.guide: Tapu Bulu is a Grass- and Fairy-type Legendary Pokémon, the guardian deity of Ula'ula Island in Alola. It controls plant life and is peaceful but merciless when angered. Its design is based on a bull and may draw on Lono, the Hawaiian god of agriculture.
description.tagline: Ula'ula's laid-back bull guardian, until you cross it
